title: Eraser: interior erased holes REFILL on any planar rebuild — interactive eraser drag inside a fill loses its trail (only the last stamp stays erased)
description:
FIXED. Root cause: assignFaceFillsBySampling (build.ts) was last-covering-wins per loop with no parity, so a read-back hole loop (which shares the outer fill's Fill object ref) re-filled the hole on any rebuild. Fix: group fill regions by (source shape, Fill object identity) and test membership by EVEN-ODD parity within the group (outer + hole enclosure toggles OUT), last covering GROUP wins across groups. Authored shapes have distinct Fill objects -> each its own single-loop group -> union/cut/island unchanged.

Evidence (worktree dash-1425, off origin/main):
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build => exit 0.
- pnpm --filter @flash/core test -- --run => 356 files, 5822 passed | 2 skipped (0 fail).
- Failing-first repros added (all now green): planar.test.ts 'interior holes survive rebuild (task 1425)' [WINDING-COUNT PROOF + read-back idempotence + no-regression union/island]; planar-eraser.test.ts 'interior holes persist across rebuilds (task 1425)' [REPRO1 chained 3-increment interactive erase keeps all stamp centers erased; REPRO2 erase-then-overlapping-commit keeps hole; REPRO3 picking/livePlanarShape sees hole empty].
- docs/36 fill-assignment contract updated (winding/parity note).
